summary: Ban Suan Cooking School on Koh Chang runs three-hour Thai cooking classes priced by the number of dishes chosen.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: 1,400 THB per person for 3 dishes, up to 2,000 THB for 7 dishes

facts.label: Curry pastes
facts.value: Students pick a curry paste to make, including red, green, panaeng, yellow, massaman and khao soi
